_**Agent**_

I've implemented the command options filtering feature for the OracleInput component. Now when you press the "/" key:

1. The command options dropdown will appear showing all available commands
2. As you type after the slash, it will filter commands based on what you're typing
3. You can click on a command from the dropdown to select it

The changes include:

- Added a default set of command options with descriptions
- Created state for tracking filtered command options
- Added a special key handler for the "/" key to show the command options
- Implemented filtering logic as you type after the slash
- Added a dropdown UI to display matching command options
- Made the input properly handle focus events
- Fixed command selection by simulating an Enter keypress when clicking an option

The component now supports both keyboard and mouse interaction for selecting commands, with real-time filtering as you type.
